audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart disagreed with the content layer on six of seven rows: full read Naafiri/Skill/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/Skill/Skill while content win[] read Skill/Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Malzahar/Naafiri/Malzahar.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly. Naafiri owning levels 2-5 is right — packmates plus a 450-range Eviscerate dash against a Malzahar with no mobility — and Malzahar reclaiming late is right because point-click suppression answers a single-target diver.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Skill, [1]/[2]/[3] -> Naafiri, [5] -> Naafiri, [6] -> Malzahar, each with its why rewritten in the same proposal. No paired win[N] edits: the content layer already holds the destination value on every row, so a paired edit would be a rejected no-op.

audit.why: Spike order is right: Naafiri's window is levels 3-5 once packmates are online, Malzahar flips it at 6, Naafiri's first-item R roams (110/95/80s, movement speed) tilt the map, and two items returns it to Malzahar. Her W rank-up (26s down to 18s) is the untracked spike — the untargetable window becomes near-permanent.
audit.corrected: Recorded the W cooldown curve in breakdown.cooldowns and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named a non-existent Malzahar passive, 'Iron Boundary', and held no digit. The packet flags zero sequencing cues. The decisive interaction — Naafiri has THREE untargetable windows (The Call of the Pack (W), Eviscerate (E), Hounds' Pursuit (R)) that eat a committed Malzahar rotation, and her R recast shields her — was never stated. Her Eviscerate heals the pack, so anti-heal timing matters and was only vaguely gestured at.
audit.why: Riot text: W 'becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack'; E 'dashes and damages... recalling her packmates and fully healing them'; R 'second cast grants a shield'. Malzahar's passive is Void Shift (damage reduction + CC immunity), not a spell shield called Iron Boundary.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80s, The Call of the Pack 26s->18s, Eviscerate 11s->7s, and the untargetable/shield warning; tradeBad names the three untargetable windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: No 'wait for X before you Y' line existed anywhere (packet defect: sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Naafiri's punishable cooldown is The Call of the Pack (W) at 26s rank 1 — her untargetable engage. Your Q is 6s, so poking it out is free; her Eviscerate at 7-11s is the step-in to silence.
audit.corrected: tradeGood now sequences: bait W, then commit inside the 18-26s window. dosFull[1].d sequences the silence onto the Eviscerate cast.

edits.before: He has to dive a spell shield, a silence, and a suppression — the math says he dies more often than you do.
edits.after: She has to dive Void Shift, a silence, and a suppression — the math says she dies more often than you do.

edits.before: Tax his roams with permanent shove, shield-silence the dive, and Grasp the over-commit. Shorthand: Hounds’ Pursuit down, wave right, go.

edits.before: Naafiri wins by landing Hounds’ Pursuit, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Naafiri wins by killing you before 6: packmate daggers, a 450-range Eviscerate dash, and no escape on your side of it.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Pop-and-punish: E her from 650 and step back so packmates chase, then Q-W-E the 18-26s window after The Call of the Pack (W) is spent.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Trading into her with Void Shift down — she has three untargetable windows (W, E, R) and you have no dash of your own.

notes: Chart: the full layer disagreed with content on six of seven rows and now matches content and packet.levelChart on all seven (Skill/Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Malzahar/Naafiri/Malzahar). No win[N] edits were proposed because the content layer already held every destination value — a paired edit would have been a no-op and would have taken the whole atomic chart group down. Ratings left untouched: I could not tell from the data whether phases[N].rating means owner difficulty or row weight, and guessing would risk the chart group. FABRICATED NAME KILLED: breakdown.cooldowns called Malzahar's passive 'Iron Boundary'; it is Void Shift, and it is damage reduction plus CC immunity, not a spell shield. Several surviving fields still loosely call it 'the spell shield' — a mislabel, not a fabrication, so left alone. REPORT CAP: lint flagged report[0], [1], [3], [4], [7], [8], [9], [11]; the sweep permits at most two report rewrites, so I took report[0].t and report[9].t. Still outstanding: report[1].t, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[8].t and report[11].t carry the same 'his' misgender (their source fields winCon/tradeGood/tradeBad/breakdown.wave ARE fixed here), and report[7].t has UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE ('TP doubles your shove-tax map game').

unverified: Whether Nether Grasp can be cast on Naafiri while The Call of the Pack (W), Eviscerate (E) or Hounds' Pursuit (R) untargetability is active, and whether an already-channelling suppression persists through her going untargetable. Riot's text gives the untargetable flag but not the interaction, so I wrote 'do not spend Q into the dive' rather than asserting the R behaviour.
Whether Void Shift's CC immunity prevents Hounds' Pursuit's slow or only reduces its damage.
Whether Eviscerate's heal applies to Naafiri herself or only to packmates — Riot's text says 'fully healing them' (the packmates), so I did not write an anti-heal timing claim about her own sustain.
